# Methodology

![Figure 1: Schematic of the studied catchment and their treatments](Figure1_procreate_sweden.jpg){fig-align="center"}

## Study Site and Treatment:

- The DC sites received different treatments:

  - Forest in all four sites was clearcut - around July 2020.

  - Two sites, DC1 and DC3, were also ditch cleaned - in September 2021.

  - The treatments are named as follow (pristine, clear-cut and ditch cleaning)

- Site Naming:

  - DC1: FC-DC-1

  - DC2: FC-1

  - DC3: FC-DC-2

  - DC4: FC-2

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=F}
# Import libraries
library(tidyverse) 
library(plotly) 
library(readxl) 
library(DT) # for interactive datatables
library(leaflet) #for interactive maps
library(htmltools)
library(rstatix) #anova test
library(ggpubr)# show reg.line equation 
library(ggcorrplot)


#Open dataset
DC_Q_all <- readRDS(file= "Output/Data/DC_Cs_Q_Meteo_chem_14C.rds")
DC_Q_all$Date <- as.Date(DC_Q_all$Date)
DC_Q <- DC_Q_all %>% filter(!Site_id %in% c("C1","C2"))


# Rename site Id to more meaningful names
DC_Q$Site_id <- dplyr::recode(DC_Q$Site_id, DC1 = 'FC_DC1', 
                                     DC2 = 'FC_1',
                                     DC3 = 'FC_DC2',
                                     DC4=  'FC_2'
                                    )

DC_Q$Site_pairs <- dplyr::recode(DC_Q$Site_id, FC_1 = 'FC', 
                                     FC_DC1 = 'FC_DC',
                                     FC_DC2 = 'FC_DC',
                                     FC_2=  'FC',
                                    )


# Order factors site pairs 
DC_Q$Site_id <- factor(DC_Q$Site_id, 
                       levels = c("FC_1","FC_2","FC_DC1",  "FC_DC2"))

DC_Q$Site_pairs <- factor(DC_Q$Site_pairs, 
                       levels = c("FC","FC_DC"))

DC_Q$Treatment <- factor(DC_Q$Treatment, 
                       levels = c("PreDisturbance","PostHarvest",
                                  "PostDrainage","2yrPostHarvest"))

DC_Q$Treatment_3class <- dplyr::recode(DC_Q$Treatment, PostDrainage = 'PostDrain_2yrsPostHarv', 
                                     '2yrPostHarvest' = 'PostDrain_2yrsPostHarv')


# Define Color Ramp and theme
treatment_colors <- c(
  "PreDisturbance" =   "#3CB7CC", # "deepskyblue",     # light blue
  "PostHarvest" = "#32A251",#"#CC6677",     # light red
  "PostDrainage" = "#FF7F0F",
  "2yrPostHarvest" = "darkgreen"#"#882255" # dark red
)


site_colors <- c(
  # Clearcut pair 
  "FC_1" = "grey11",# "#9e007c", # "#228B22", # Light orange
  "FC_2" = "grey51",#"#451159", # "#90EE90", #Dark brown
  
  # Clearcut+DitchCleaning pair
  "FC_DC1" = "steelblue4", #"gray60", #"#E69B00", #orange
  "FC_DC2" = "steelblue1" #"#ccff00" #994F00" #brown
  
)


site_symbols <- c(
  "FC_DC1" = 21, #Filled Circles    
  "FC_1" = 1,  # Hollow Circles   
  "FC_DC2" = 24, # Filled Triangles (up)
  "FC_2" =2 #Hollow triangle (up)
)

theme_set(theme_light(base_size = 16))


```

```{r, warning=F, message=F, width= 16, height=6}
dotplots_treatment_sites = function(site_pair,variable) {
   ggplot(data = DC_Q %>% filter (Site_pairs==site_pair), 
         aes( y={{ variable }}, color=Treatment, fill = Treatment,
              x=Treatment
              ) )+

    stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "line",
                 aes(group = 1), color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(treatment_colors)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(c(treatment_colors), 0.5)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values= site_symbols)+
 # facet_wrap(~Site_id, nrow=4)+
 # scale_x_discrete(limits = rev)+
  theme(legend.position = "none"
        ,axis.title.x  = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank()
        )
  
}
```

#### Dunn's test \| ¹⁴C and \[C\] per Site

```{r}
# Calculate medians for each variable by Site_id
combined_medians <- DC_Q %>%
  group_by(Site_id) %>%
  summarise(
    "[DOC]" = round(median(DOC_mgL, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    "14C-DOC" = round(median(DOC_14C_Modern, na.rm = TRUE),2),
    "[CO2]" = round(median(CO2_mgL, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    "14C-CO2" = round(median(CO2_14C_Modern, na.rm = TRUE),2),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  rename(Site = Site_id)

knitr::kable(combined_medians, 
             caption = "Median by site for DOC and CO2 concentration and 14C-content")

```

```{r,warning =F, message=F}

library(dunn.test)
library(multcompView)
library(PMCMR)



# Perform the test and get multcomp letters
DOCSites_letters = multcompLetters(get.pvalues(PMCMRplus::kwAllPairsDunnTest(
          DC_Q$DOC_mgL ~ DC_Q$Site_id, p.adjust="bonf")),
          threshold=0.05)$Letters

DOC_14C_Sites_letters = multcompLetters(get.pvalues(PMCMRplus::kwAllPairsDunnTest(
          DC_Q$DOC_14C_Modern ~ DC_Q$Site_id, p.adjust="bonf")),
          threshold=0.05)$Letters
        
CO2Sites_letters = multcompLetters(get.pvalues(PMCMRplus::kwAllPairsDunnTest(
          DC_Q$CO2_mgL ~ DC_Q$Site_id, p.adjust="bonf")),
          threshold=0.05)$Letters

CO2_C14_Sites_letters = multcompLetters(get.pvalues(PMCMRplus::kwAllPairsDunnTest(
          DC_Q$CO2_14C_Modern ~ DC_Q$Site_id, p.adjust="bonf")),
          threshold=0.05)$Letters

        
# Combine into a data frame
combined_dunns_results <- data.frame(
  Site = names(DOCSites_letters),
  "[DOC]" = as.character(DOCSites_letters),
  "14C-DOC" = as.character(DOC_14C_Sites_letters),
  "[CO2]" = as.character(CO2Sites_letters[names(DOCSites_letters)]),
  "14C-CO2" = as.character(CO2_C14_Sites_letters[names(DOCSites_letters)]),
  check.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(combined_dunns_results, 
             caption = "Grouping letters for dunn's test result")
```

```{r,warning =F, message=F}
library(dunn.test)
library(multcompView)
library(PMCMR)

# Function to perform the test and get multcomp letters
Dunns_letters = function(variable, site_pair) {
  data = DC_Q %>% filter(Site_pairs == site_pair)
  
  multcompLetters(
    get.pvalues(PMCMRplus::kwAllPairsDunnTest(
      data[[variable]] ~ data$Treatment, p.adjust = "bonf")),
    threshold = 0.05)$Letters
}

Dunns_DOC_FC= Dunns_letters(variable = "DOC_mgL", site_pair = "FC")
Dunns_14DOC_FC= Dunns_letters(variable = "DOC_14C_Modern", site_pair = "FC")
Dunns_CO2_FC= Dunns_letters(variable = "CO2_mgL", site_pair = "FC")
Dunns_14CO2_FC= Dunns_letters(variable = "CO2_14C_Modern", site_pair = "FC")

Dunns_DOC_FC_DC=Dunns_letters(variable = "DOC_mgL", site_pair = "FC_DC")
Dunns_14DOC_FC_DC= Dunns_letters(variable = "DOC_14C_Modern", site_pair = "FC_DC")
Dunns_CO2_FC_DC= Dunns_letters(variable = "CO2_mgL", site_pair = "FC_DC")
Dunns_14CO2_FC_DC=Dunns_letters(variable = "CO2_14C_Modern", site_pair = "FC_DC")

        
# Combine into a data frame
combined_dunns_FC <- data.frame(
  Site = names(Dunns_DOC_FC),
  "[DOC]"   = as.character(Dunns_DOC_FC),
  "14C-DOC" = as.character(Dunns_14DOC_FC[names(Dunns_DOC_FC)]),
  "[CO2]"   = as.character(Dunns_CO2_FC[names(Dunns_DOC_FC)]),
  "14C-CO2" = as.character(Dunns_14CO2_FC[names(Dunns_DOC_FC)]),
  check.names = FALSE
)

combined_dunns_FC_DC <- data.frame(
  Site = names(Dunns_DOC_FC_DC),
  "[DOC]"   = as.character(Dunns_DOC_FC_DC),
  "14C-DOC" = as.character(Dunns_14DOC_FC_DC[names(Dunns_DOC_FC_DC)]),
  "[CO2]"   = as.character(Dunns_CO2_FC_DC[names(Dunns_DOC_FC_DC)]),
  "14C-CO2" = as.character(Dunns_14CO2_FC_DC[names(Dunns_DOC_FC_DC)]),
  check.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(combined_dunns_FC,
             caption = "Dunn's test grouping letters by treatment — FC sites")

knitr::kable(combined_dunns_FC_DC,
             caption = "Dunn's test grouping letters by treatment — FC_DC sites")
```

## Variance partitionning (Site vs Treatment)

```{r, warning =F, message=F}

library(car)

variance_partition_table <- function(data, response) {
  f <- reformulate(c("Site_id", "Treatment_3class"), response = response)
  m <- aov(f, data = data)
  ss <- car::Anova(m, type = 2)
  ss$`%Total` <- round(100 * ss$`Sum Sq` / sum(ss$`Sum Sq`), 1)
  ss
}

vp_14CDOC <- variance_partition_table(DC_Q %>% filter(!is.na(DOC_14C_Modern)) %>%
                                     mutate(Site_id = droplevels(Site_id),
                                            Treatment_3class = droplevels(Treatment_3class)),
                                   "DOC_14C_Modern")



vp_14CCO2 <- variance_partition_table(DC_Q %>% filter(!is.na(CO2_14C_Modern)) %>%
                                     mutate(Site_id = droplevels(Site_id),
                                            Treatment_3class = droplevels(Treatment_3class)),
                                   "CO2_14C_Modern")

vp_DOC <- variance_partition_table(DC_Q %>% filter(!is.na(CO2_mgL)) %>%
                                     mutate(Site_id = droplevels(Site_id),
                                            Treatment_3class = droplevels(Treatment_3class)),
                                   "CO2_mgL_filled")

vp_CO2 <- variance_partition_table(DC_Q %>% filter(!is.na(DOC_mgL)) %>%
                                     mutate(Site_id = droplevels(Site_id),
                                            Treatment_3class = droplevels(Treatment_3class)),
                                   "DOC_mgL_filled")

library(kableExtra)

combine_variance_tables <- function(table_list,
                                    caption = "Variance partitioning: Site + Treatment (Type II SS)") {
  # table_list: a NAMED list of variance_partition_table() outputs --
  # the names become the subsection headers, in the order given.
  combined <- purrr::imap_dfr(table_list, function(tbl, name) {
    tbl %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Term")
  })
  
  group_sizes <- sapply(table_list, nrow)
  end   <- cumsum(group_sizes)
  start <- end - group_sizes + 1
  
  kbl <- combined %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = caption, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
  
  for (i in seq_along(table_list)) {
    kbl <- kableExtra::pack_rows(kbl, names(table_list)[i], start[i], end[i])
  }
  
  kbl
}


combine_variance_tables(list(
  "14C-DOC (% modern)" = vp_14CDOC,
  "14C-CO2 (% modern)" = vp_14CCO2,
  "DOC (mg/L)"         = vp_DOC,
  "CO2 (mg/L)"         = vp_CO2
))


```

Visualising variance partitionning

```{r}
variance_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  list("14C-DOC" = vp_14CDOC, "14C-CO2" = vp_14CCO2, "DOC" = vp_DOC, "CO2" = vp_CO2),
  function(tbl, name) {
    tbl %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") %>% mutate(Response = name)
  }
) %>%
  mutate(
    Term = dplyr::recode(Term, Site_id = "Site", Treatment_3class = "Treatment", Residuals = "Residual"),
    Term = factor(Term, levels = c("Residual", "Treatment", "Site")),
    Response = factor(Response, levels = c( "14C-CO2","14C-DOC", "CO2", "DOC" )),
    label_color = if_else(Term == "Residual", "#0b0b0b", "white")
  )

variance_colors <- c(Site = "#2a78d6", Treatment = "#eb6834", Residual = "gray80")


ggplot(variance_long, aes(x = Response, y = `%Total`, fill = Term)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = if_else(`%Total` >= 4, paste0(`%Total`, "%"), ""), color = label_color),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3.8, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variance_colors, breaks = c("Site", "Treatment", "Residual")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of total variance", fill = NULL) +
  theme_light(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

```{r, warning =F, message=F,fig.height=7, fig.width=7, fig.cap="relationship between C concentration and radiocarbon content of CO2 and DOC coloured by treatment"}
Cscatter_function <- function(data, group_var, color_values, fill_values = alpha(color_values, 0.5)) {
```

```{r, warning =F, message=FALSE}
# --- Linear regression tables ---

extract_lm_results_14C <- function(y_var) { #site_pair
  DC_Q %>%
    #filter(Site_pairs == site_pair) %>%
    group_by(Treatment) %>%
    group_map(~ {
      model <- lm(.x[[y_var]] ~ .x$q_int_mmd)
      s <- summary(model)
      coefs <- coef(model)
      ci <- confint(model, level = 0.95)   # row 1 = intercept, row 2 = slope
      
      f <- s$fstatistic
      p_val <- if (!is.null(f)) pf(f[1], f[2], f[3], lower.tail = FALSE) else NA
      
      tibble(
        #Site_pair  = site_pair,
        Treatment  = .y$Treatment,
        Response   = y_var,
        Intercept  = round(coefs[1], 3),
        Intercept_CIlow  = round(ci[1, 1], 3),
        Intercept_CIhigh = round(ci[1, 2], 3),
        Slope      = round(coefs[2], 3),
        Slope_CIlow      = round(ci[2, 1], 3),
        Slope_CIhigh     = round(ci[2, 2], 3),
        R2_adj     = round(s$adj.r.squared, 3),
        P_value    = signif(p_val, 3),
        n          = nrow(.x)
      )
    }) %>%
    bind_rows()
}

# Extract for all combinations
lm_14C_results <- bind_rows(
  extract_lm_results_14C( y_var=  "DOC_14C_Modern"),
  #extract_lm_results_14C("FC_DC",  y_var=  "DOC_14C_Modern"),
  extract_lm_results_14C( y_var= "CO2_14C_Modern"),
  #extract_lm_results_14C("FC_DC",  y_var=  "CO2_14C_Modern")
)
```

### Mixed effect model

```{r, warning = F, message = F}
# ---- Mixed-effects robustness check: 14C-DOC ~ discharge x Treatment, with Site as random effect ----
# install.packages(c("lme4", "lmerTest", "broom.mixed"))  # run once if not already installed
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)     # adds Type III F-tests (Satterthwaite df) on top of lme4's lmer()
library(broom.mixed)  # tidy() for mixed-model output, parallel to broom::tidy() for lm()

# Use sum-to-zero contrasts so Type III tests below match how rstatix::anova_test()
# computes your existing ANCOVA table (avoids misleading Type III SS with treatment contrasts).
# Reset back to defaults after, since options() are global for the whole document.
old_contrasts <- options("contrasts")
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

# Core 4 treatment catchments only, dropping the 2 reference sites (DC_Q_noRef already
# does this) and dropping now-unused factor levels so they don't interfere with the model.
DC_Q_mixed <- DC_Q %>%
  filter(!is.na(DOC_14C_Modern), !is.na(q_int_mmd)) %>%
  mutate(Treatment_3class = droplevels(Treatment_3class),
         Site_id = droplevels(Site_id))

# --- Fixed-effects-only model, i.e. your existing ANCOVA, refit here for direct comparison ---
ancova_fixed <- lm(DOC_14C_Modern ~ q_int_mmd * Treatment_3class, data = DC_Q_mixed)

# --- Mixed-effects model: same fixed-effects structure, + random intercept per Site_id ---
mm_DOC_q <- lmer(DOC_14C_Modern ~ q_int_mmd * Treatment_3class + (1 | Site_id),
                 data = DC_Q_mixed)

# Check fit quality -- TRUE means singular fit (see note above)
isSingular(mm_DOC_q)

# --- Mixed-model ANCOVA table: directly comparable to your existing ANCOVA table ---
knitr::kable(anova(mm_DOC_q, type = 3),
             caption = "Mixed-effects ANCOVA: 14C-DOC ~ discharge x Treatment, Site as random intercept")

# --- Is the random effect (Site) actually needed? ---
# Likelihood-ratio test: mixed model vs. the fixed-effects-only model above.
# Significant -> samples are meaningfully clustered by site; the plain ANCOVA risked
#   overstating significance, and this result should be reported.
# Non-significant -> clustering by site is not detectable with this data, supporting
#   the original ANCOVA as an adequate approach.
ranova(mm_DOC_q)

# --- Fixed-effect estimates, for a clean table alongside your existing lm_14C_results ---
knitr::kable(tidy(mm_DOC_q, effects = "fixed"),
             caption = "Fixed-effect estimates: mixed model 14C-DOC ~ q x Treatment + (1|Site)")

# Restore default contrasts for the rest of the document
options(old_contrasts)
```

```{r, warning = F, message = F}
extract_keeling_lm <- function(response_var, filter_var) {
  model <- lm(reformulate("CO2_mgL_filled_keeling", response = response_var),
              data = DC_Q %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[filter_var]])))
  s <- summary(model)
  coefs <- coef(model)
  f <- s$fstatistic
  p_val <- if (!is.null(f)) pf(f[1], f[2], f[3], lower.tail = FALSE) else NA

  tibble(
    Response  = response_var,
    Intercept = round(coefs[1], 3),
    Slope     = round(coefs[2], 3),
    R2_adj    = round(s$adj.r.squared, 3),
    P_value   = signif(p_val, 3),
    n         = nrow(DC_Q %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[filter_var]])))
  )
}

keeling_lm_results <- bind_rows(
  extract_keeling_lm("CO2_14C_Modern", "CO2_14C_Modern"),
  extract_keeling_lm("d13C_CO2",       "d13C_CO2")
)

             caption = "Keeling plot linear regression results: 14C-CO2 and d13C-CO2 vs 1/CO2")
```

```{r, warning=F, message=F,fig.height=10, fig.width=12, fig.cap="C concentration and radiocarbon content timeseries coloured by sites"}
plot_timeseries = function(data, y_var,labs_y, 
                           ymin_rect, ymax_rect) 
  {
  ggplot(data, aes(x=Date, y=!!sym(y_var), 
                   group=Site_id, color=Site_id, 
                   fill=Site_id, shape=Site_id)) +
  
  # Add gray background bars for operations

  annotate("rect", xmin = predisturbance_start, xmax = predisturbance_end,
           ymin = ymin_rect, ymax = ymax_rect,
           fill = "#3CB7CC", alpha = 0.3) +
  
  
    
  annotate("rect", xmin = postharvest_start, xmax = postharvest_end,
           ymin = ymin_rect, ymax = ymax_rect,
           fill = "#32A251", alpha = 0.3) +  
  
  
    
  annotate("rect", xmin = postditch_start, xmax = postditch_end,
           ymin = ymin_rect, ymax = ymax_rect,
           fill = "#FF7F0F", alpha = 0.3) +    
    
  annotate("rect", 
           xmin = clearcut_start, xmax = clearcut_end,
           ymin = ymin_rect, ymax = ymax_rect,
           fill = "#32A251",, alpha = 0.5) +
    
  annotate("rect", 
           xmin = ditch_cleaning_start, xmax = ditch_cleaning_end,
           ymin = ymin_rect, ymax = ymax_rect,
           fill = "#FF7F0F", alpha = 0.5) +
    
    
     geom_line(data=data[!is.na(data[[y_var]]), ]) +
    geom_point(size=3, aes(color = Treatment)) +
    
    scale_x_date(limits=c(as.Date("2020-01-01"), as.Date("2022-11-01")),
                 date_labels = "%b-%Y", date_breaks = "6 months") +
    scale_color_manual(values=c(site_colors))+
    scale_fill_manual(values=alpha(c(site_colors), 0.7))+

    scale_shape_manual(values=c(site_symbols))+
    labs(y=labs_y)+
    facet_wrap(~Site_pairs)+
    theme( # set margins to align combined plots 
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5, "pt"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(size = 0.25)
    )

}
```

## Correlation between discharge measurement at both stations

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
library(scales)

# Uses q_int_mmd (specific discharge, short gaps already filled by Mosquera) 
q_full <- DC_Q %>%
  filter(Site_id %in% c("FC_1", "FC_DC2")) %>%
  distinct(Date, Site_id, q_int_mmd) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Date, names_from = Site_id, values_from = q_int_mmd,
              names_prefix = "q_") %>%
  filter(!is.na(q_FC_1), !is.na(q_FC_DC2))

lm_full <- lm(log(q_FC_DC2) ~ log(q_FC_1), data = q_full)
r_full  <- cor.test(log(q_full$q_FC_1), log(q_full$q_FC_DC2))
cat("Full record (q_int_mmd): n =", nrow(q_full),
    " r =", round(r_full$estimate, 3),
    " 95% CI [", round(r_full$conf.int[1], 3), ",", round(r_full$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n")

# ---- Subset to the dates 14C-DOC was actually sampled ----
# 14C-DOC campaigns don't always hit both sites on the exact same calendar day, so
# we take the union of sampling dates from either site, then look up q_int_mmd at
# BOTH sites on each of those dates from the full discharge record (not just the
# rows where 14C happens to have been sampled) -- this keeps legitimate 14C-DOC
# samples in the set even when the paired site wasn't visited that exact day.
c14_dates <- DC_Q %>%
  filter(!is.na(DOC_14C_Modern), Site_id %in% c("FC_1", "FC_DC2")) %>%
  distinct(Date, Site_id)

q_at_14C <- DC_Q %>%
  filter(Site_id %in% c("FC_1", "FC_DC2")) %>%
  distinct(Date, Site_id, q_int_mmd) %>%
  filter(Date %in% c14_dates$Date) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Date, names_from = Site_id, values_from = q_int_mmd,
              names_prefix = "q_") %>%
  arrange(Date)

cat("\n14C sampling dates (FC_1 or FC_DC2), q_int_mmd at both sites:\n")
print(q_at_14C, n = Inf)

q_at_14C_complete <- q_at_14C %>% filter(!is.na(q_FC_1), !is.na(q_FC_DC2))
n_14c <- nrow(q_at_14C_complete)
cat("\nDates usable for this check (q_int_mmd present at BOTH sites, same day):",
    n_14c, "out of", nrow(q_at_14C), "candidate 14C sampling dates\n")
cat("Dropped -- no same-day q_int_mmd at one or both sites (e.g. falls in the\n",
    "end-of-record sensor gap):\n")
print(q_at_14C %>% filter(is.na(q_FC_1) | is.na(q_FC_DC2)))

r_14c <- cor.test(log(q_at_14C_complete$q_FC_1), log(q_at_14C_complete$q_FC_DC2))
cat("\n14C-sampling-day subset: n =", n_14c,
    " r =", round(r_14c$estimate, 3),
    " 95% CI [", round(r_14c$conf.int[1], 3), ",", round(r_14c$conf.int[2], 3), "]",
    " (Fisher-z CI, wide because n is small -- interpret descriptively, not as a\n",
    " standalone significance test)\n")

# Visualization 
p_overlay <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = q_full, aes(x = q_FC_1, y = q_FC_DC2),
             color = "grey75", alpha = 0.5, size = 1.3) +
  geom_smooth(data = q_full, aes(x = q_FC_1, y = q_FC_DC2),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(data = q_at_14C_complete, aes(x = q_FC_1, y = q_FC_DC2),
             color = "#d95f02", size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number()) +
  annotate("text", x = min(q_full$q_FC_1), y = max(q_full$q_FC_DC2), hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           label = paste0("grey: all days, n=", nrow(q_full), ", r=", round(r_full$estimate, 2),
                          "\norange: 14C sampling days, n=", n_14c, ", r=", round(r_14c$estimate, 2))) +
  labs(x = "q at FC_1 (mm/d)",
       y = "q at FC_DC2 (mm/d)"
       )

p_overlay

ggsave("Output/Figures/SupFigure_discharge_at_14C_dates.pdf", plot = p_overlay,
       height = 5.5, width = 6.5)
```

#### Linear regressions

```{r}
lm_C_q_results <- DC_Q %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(DOC_mgL, CO2_mgL),
               names_to = "Carbon_species",
               values_to = "C_mgL") %>%
  filter(!is.na(C_mgL), !is.na(q_int_mmd), C_mgL > 0, q_int_mmd > 0) %>%
  group_by(Carbon_species, Site_id, Treatment) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    data <- .x
    
    if (nrow(data) < 3) {
      return(tibble(Intercept = NA, Slope = NA, R2_adj = NA, P_value = NA, n = nrow(data)))
    }
    
    model <- lm(log10(C_mgL) ~ log10(q_int_mmd), data = data)
    s <- summary(model)
    coefs <- coef(model)
    f <- s$fstatistic
    p_val <- if (!is.null(f)) pf(f[1], f[2], f[3], lower.tail = FALSE) else NA
    
    tibble(
      Intercept = round(coefs[1], 3),
      Slope     = round(coefs[2], 3),
      R2_adj    = round(s$adj.r.squared, 3),
      P_value   = signif(p_val, 3),
      n         = nrow(data)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Carbon_species, Site_id, Treatment)

knitr::kable(lm_C_q_results,
             caption = "Linear regression results (log10-log10): C concentration ~ discharge by species, site and treatment")
```

# Summary tables

```{r,warning=F, message=F, echo=F}

library(lubridate)

# Extract rows with 14C data (either DOC or CO2)
C14_data <- DC_Q %>%
  filter(!is.na(DOC_14C_Modern) | !is.na(CO2_14C_Modern))

# Overall date range
date_summary <- C14_data %>%
  summarise(
    first_sampling = min(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_sampling = max(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_days = as.numeric(last_sampling - first_sampling),
    total_samples = n()
  )

cat("Overall 14C sampling period:\n")
print(date_summary)

# Sample counts by site and type
sample_counts <- C14_data %>%
  group_by(Site_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_DOC_14C = sum(!is.na(DOC_14C_Modern)),
    n_CO2_14C = sum(!is.na(CO2_14C_Modern)),
    n_both = sum(!is.na(DOC_14C_Modern) & !is.na(CO2_14C_Modern)),
    first_date = min(Date),
    last_date = max(Date)
  )

cat("\n14C samples by site:\n")
print(sample_counts)

# Calculate intervals between measurements for each site
intervals_by_site <- C14_data %>%
  arrange(Site_id, Date) %>%
  group_by(Site_id) %>%
  mutate(
    days_since_last = as.numeric(Date - lag(Date))
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_interval_days = mean(days_since_last, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_interval_days = median(days_since_last, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_interval_days = min(days_since_last, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_interval_days = max(days_since_last, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cat("\nSampling intervals by site (days):\n")
print(intervals_by_site)

# More detailed view: all sampling dates and intervals
detailed_intervals <- C14_data %>%
  select(Date, Site_id, DOC_14C_Modern, CO2_14C_Modern) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    days_since_previous = as.numeric(Date - lag(Date)),
    sample_type = case_when(
      !is.na(DOC_14C_Modern) & !is.na(CO2_14C_Modern) ~ "Both",
      !is.na(DOC_14C_Modern) ~ "DOC only",
      !is.na(CO2_14C_Modern) ~ "CO2 only"
    )
  )

cat("\nFirst 10 sampling events with intervals:\n")
print(head(detailed_intervals, 10))

# Summary statistics
cat("\n=== SUMMARY ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Total 14C samples collected: %d\n", nrow(C14_data)))
cat(sprintf("Sampling period: %s to %s (%d days)\n", 
            date_summary$first_sampling, 
            date_summary$last_sampling,
            date_summary$total_days))
cat(sprintf("Average sampling interval: %.1f days\n", 
            mean(detailed_intervals$days_since_previous, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("Number of sites sampled: %d\n", n_distinct(C14_data$Site_id)))



# Total counts by site and sample type
total_by_type <- C14_data %>%
  group_by(Site_id) %>%
  summarise(
    `14C-DOC samples` = sum(!is.na(DOC_14C_Modern)),
    `14C-CO2 samples` = sum(!is.na(CO2_14C_Modern))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Site_id)

cat("\nTotal 14C samples by type at each site:\n")
print(total_by_type)
```
